Class Player

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsw.galaxytruckerproject.model.player.Player
All Implemented Interfaces:
PlayerInterface, Serializable
public class Player extends Object implements PlayerInterface, Serializable
Represents a player in the Galaxy Trucker game. A player has a name, color, ship, crew, cargo, credits, and various gameplay states like landing or disconnection. This class handles interactions with the ship, including: - managing crew - handling engines and cannons - placing and removing goods - using shields and batteries - serialization/deserialization for saving/loading game state Implements PlayerInterface and is Serializable.
